failures: The final-evaluation reserve stopped training before the exact 320-completion budget was reached.
The automatic retry mapped CUDA RNG checkpoint tensors into a representation rejected by torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all.

hardware_preference.from: first available RunPod GPU with at least 32 GB under the amended ceiling
hardware_preference.to: NVIDIA L40S on RunPod community cloud

changes.resume_compatibility: Normalize restored CUDA RNG states to non-empty one-dimensional CPU uint8 tensors before the frozen resume path uses them.
changes.completion_budget_diagnostic: Report the expected and observed sampled-completion counts when a failed attempt cannot satisfy the exact-budget invariant.

rationale.hardware: The L40 completed final evaluation but was marginally too slow to consume the fixed budget before the preregistered reserve. RunPod had previously quoted the faster L40S at $0.79/hour.
rationale.resume: The normalization preserves the checkpointed RNG bytes and changes only their dtype and device representation. It does not alter seeds, sampling, gradients, rewards, or accepted results.
rationale.study_integrity: No revision-31 condition had produced an accepted result when this amendment was recorded. The amended source is refrozen before rerunning any factorial cell.
